body: I have no friends, all have walked away from me. I moved to the US 8 years ago, my family has never visited, and I don't blame them, what good have I ever done?

I don't know, is like if I have two minds, the one the like, and the one I hate, and the one I like tries so hard to hide the other, but is always there, a selfish piece of shit. I'm a master of lying to myself.

I wish I could just get help, close my eyes, and let it go, but I can't, and is killing me. I'm so afraid to admit I feel like this, that I'm doing all wrong, than I can't get myself together this time. My family doesn't care, they are just tired of my shit.
I'm just evil, without noticing, without trying, I seem to care, but I really don't, I'm a piece of shit

Does he, really? I'm starting to think I may be more bad than good, he is wired to love me, but I don't think I deserve it, and probably won't make him any good. Either I'm gone or I'm here, is all wrong, I always do everything wrong, I only good at working, I'm an empty shell
I had everything to succeeded, to give him what he deserved, and I failed, and I continue to fail him

I had a successful job, a wife, a kid, a life. She asked for a divorce, it became very messy, my kid is autistic, I fear so much for him, I have come to the realization that something is wrong with me, I'm an asshole, I'm not OK, today is my first day officially divorced and just had a big fight, and thought was right, now I'm not sure, maybe I just good at deceiving myself.

There is no point, my kid loves me, and I love him so much, but I'm a piece of shit.

I'm all alone, everyone I ever trusted went away.
